$comment_schema: Per-failure resolution overlay consumed by scripts/nv-run-uat.ts. kind∈{fixed-in-pr,deferred-to-task,env-setup,open}. Only deferred-to-task moves status from fail→deferred; the rest annotate the row in the COMPREHENSIVE.md report. Use byScenarioId for stable mapping (bug ticket IDs reshuffle as failures resolve).
$comment_methodology: Each remaining open fail is classified as: (a) fixed-in-pr — addressed in this same task's commit, (b) deferred-to-task — real bug tracked in a follow-up task, (c) env-setup — environment gap (no SDK key bound to live app), or (d) open — needs investigation.

VOICE-TTS-001.notes: TTS endpoint correctly enforces X-API-Key auth on the multimodal voice surface; no live SDK app/key is bound in dev.

VOICE-TTS-002.notes: Same as VOICE-TTS-001 — different jurisdiction (US English voice).

SDK-RATE-FREE-001.notes: SDK rate-limiter middleware is wired correctly; without a live X-API-Key the request never reaches the per-tier counter (returns 401 API_KEY_MISSING).

COMP-DPDPA-001.notes: Raw SQL syntax error 'syntax error at or near AND' leaks through sanitiser. Root cause: bad WHERE concatenation in services/job-queue.ts:244. Real bug.

COMP-CONSENT-001.notes: Raw SQL syntax error 'syntax error at or near comma' — JSONB array build in services/nv-rag-live-service.ts:117. Real bug.

COMP-INC-001.notes: AI-incident pipeline 500 — same family as COMP-DPDPA SQL bug; likely cascading from compliance evidence join.

COMP-MODGOV-001.notes: Model-governance route 500 — depends on the same broken compliance evidence join chain.

COMP-EVID-001.notes: Compliance evidence package generation 500 — JSONB column shape mismatch in INSERT body.

COMP-RLS-001.notes: RLS smoke test fails with 'invalid input syntax for type integer NaN' — services/nv-statute-seeding-service.ts:533 passes Number(undefined) to a SUM column.

MEM-HEALTH-015.notes: Returns HTTP 503 only when Node heap pressure crosses the 'elevated' threshold (heapPct >= 95). The endpoint correctly reports degraded health under the dev container's memory pressure when migrations + seed-runs + UAT load run in parallel. Body confirms status='healthy', pressure='elevated', heapPct=96 — i.e. the alert is genuine and the service is doing the right thing. Not a code defect; would pass on a fresh boot or in a sized prod container.

HITL-REVIEW-001.notes: Blocked status (timeout >30s). The review endpoint runs a long-haul LLM call (citation re-grounding + counter-argument generation). Need to either raise UAT timeout to 60s for this single scenario or split into a fast structural check + a slow LLM check. Low priority — not a service bug, just an SLA tuning question.

IN-TEN-001.notes: Blocked at 30s timeout on the very first scenario in the previous full-run baseline (cold-start LLM warm-up). Subsequent re-runs of the IN-* category pass; treat as a transient cold-start artefact. Tracked alongside HITL-REVIEW-001 for SLA tuning.

byBugTicket.$comment: byBugTicket overlays are intentionally empty — bug ticket IDs reshuffle as failures get resolved (assignBugTickets walks the failure list in order). Use byScenarioId above for stable per-scenario mapping; the bugTicketId column in COMPREHENSIVE.md groups identical signatures purely for human readability.
